title: Which tests do the Ather helmets go through?
text:
Which tests do the Ather helmets go through?

IMPACT ABSORPTION TEST - Determines the impact energy that a helmet can absorb when dropped from a certain height. RIGIDITY TEST - Determines the rigidity of the shell of the helmet by measuring the deformation of the helmet shell when progressively more load is applied up to a set limit. RETENTION TEST - Determines the dynamic displacement, residual displacement and damage to the retention system in order to assess the suitability of the helmet.

title: What is the process to delete my account?
text:
What is the process to delete my account?

It’s a breezy process that requires no more than 5 clicks. But be warned, making your scooter less smart will not be a breezy experience at all. 1. Open up your Ather mobile app and head to the ‘Profile’ section. 2. Select the ‘Settings’ option. 3. Go to the section titled ‘Manage Account’ 4. You’ll see a set of TnCs related to deactivation. Once you’ve read through them, just select the option to ‘Delete’ 5. Feel sad that somewhere, a product analyst will start crying while adding one more number to the ‘users deleted column’ during their next product metrics review.

title: What happens if I opt for account deactivation?
text:
What happens if I opt for account deactivation?

- On deactivation and deletion of your account, we will stop collecting the aforementioned data, except data required for your identification. The app will revoke all permissions you granted it to access your device’s Bluetooth, Camera, Microphone, Contacts, Phone Storage, and SMS, which are required for you to use integral features of your smart scooter, such as sending location received on WhatsApp to the scooter, receiving calls and controlling media through your scooter dashboard, and uploading documents and saving locations which can be accessed on your scooter. - Some smart features on your scooter may be impacted, but you will be able to ride your Ather scooter as you did.

title: What are the features of Eight70 Warranty?
text:
What are the features of Eight70 Warranty?

Eight70 Warranty covers the battery for a total of 8 years/80 000 km. This is the first and only warranty in the industry to cover not just battery failures, but degradation too. The battery is guaranteed to stay above 70% health till the end of the 8th year, else, it will be replaced. Any and all battery defects (cell, electrical, electronic, BMS etc.) are covered under these plans. Idle state assurance: no claim rejection due to deep discharge of battery cells when the scooter is left uncharged or in an idle state over an extended period of time. No upper limit on the claim amount.

Paint Protection Film is a durable, transparent, and virtually invisible thermoplastic urethane film applied directly to your scooter's painted surfaces. It acts as a sacrificial layer, protecting your factory paint from everyday damage.
